name: TripoSplat
description: Single image to 3D via feed-forward Gaussian Splatting (up to 262k Gaussians), reconstructed into a vertex-colored mesh. By Tripo AI / VAST AI Research. Requires ~10GB VRAM.
author: Lorchie

params_schema.label: Sampling Steps
params_schema.tooltip: Number of diffusion sampling steps. More steps = cleaner Gaussians but slower.

params_schema.label: Gaussians
params_schema.tooltip: Number of Gaussians to decode. More = denser point cloud and finer mesh detail.

params_schema.label: Mesh Detail
params_schema.tooltip: Surface-Nets grid resolution. Higher = finer surface detail (ears, edges) but slower and more triangles.

params_schema.label: Mesh Smoothing
params_schema.tooltip: Taubin smoothing applied during reconstruction. Lower keeps crisper edges/relief; higher gives a softer, rounder surface.

params_schema.label: Color Mode
params_schema.tooltip: Natural matches ComfyUI's color exactly. Vivid pre-boosts saturation to offset the viewer's tone-mapping. Refined fits the colors (vertex colors, or texture texels with Baked 1K/2K) to multi-view renders of the Gaussian splat — measurably closer to the splat's look.

params_schema.label: Texture
params_schema.tooltip: Auto: builds BOTH refined color paths (vertex colors and a baked 2K texture fitted to splat renders) and keeps whichever matches the splat best on held-out validation views — the most faithful result on any object type. Vertex colors: fast single path. Baked 1K/2K: always use a UV texture.

params_schema.label: Seed
params_schema.tooltip: Seed for reproducibility. Set to -1 for a random seed.

params_schema.label: Sampling Steps
params_schema.tooltip: Number of diffusion sampling steps. More steps = cleaner Gaussians but slower.

params_schema.label: Gaussians
params_schema.tooltip: Number of Gaussians to decode. More = denser, higher-fidelity splat.

params_schema.label: Seed
params_schema.tooltip: Seed for reproducibility. Set to -1 for a random seed.

params_schema.label: Color Projection
params_schema.tooltip: Projects the splat's color onto the wired mesh via inverse-distance k-NN. Both modes auto-correct gross rotation (yaw) and drop transparent floater gaussians. Aligned (ICP) adds an ICP registration step for the residual fine misalignment.

params_schema.label: Color Boost
params_schema.tooltip: The viewer shows vertex color as-is, so raw splat colors look dark. Vivid boosts saturation (native formula); Bright applies a gamma lift so whites read white instead of grey. Vivid + Bright does both.

params_schema.label: Sampling Steps
params_schema.tooltip: Diffusion steps for the internally-generated splat used as the color source. More = cleaner color but slower.

params_schema.label: Gaussians
params_schema.tooltip: Number of Gaussians decoded for the color source. More = denser color sampling on the mesh.

params_schema.label: Seed
params_schema.tooltip: Seed for reproducibility. Set to -1 for a random seed.
